varmodel_fit — SPC variation op

• データ種: video → table

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.varmodel_fit(stack, spread='moderated', far=0.001, align='check', max_misalign_px=0.5, spread_floor=0.0, mask=None, *, chunk=262144) (実装を直接呼ぶなら import varmodel; varmodel.varmodel_fit(stack, spread='moderated', far=0.001, align='check', max_misalign_px=0.5, spread_floor=0.0, mask=None, *, chunk=262144)、台帳から引くなら opsspc.get("varmodel_fit"))

使い方

Learn a per-pixel variation model (centre, spread, band half-width k) from a stack of good samples (table).

stack is (n, H, W) or a list of equal 2-D images, all good. spread chooses the estimator (SPREADS): std (mean / per-pixel sample std, needs n >= 3), pooled (mean / one std for all valid pixels — few samples, homoscedastic noise), moderated (mean / empirical-Bayes shrinkage of every pixel's variance toward a prior estimated from all pixels, Smyth 2004 — few samples, heteroscedastic noise; the default) or mad (median / 1.4826 MAD — robust to a few defective images hidden in the "good" set, needs n >= 5). far is the declared two-sided per-pixel false-alarm rate; k follows from it (see varmodel_band_k) and is never tuned on defects.

Alignment: align="check" measures every sample's translation (varmodel_alignment) and REFUSES the stack if any exceeds max_misalign_px; align="translate" registers the samples to the median by a Fourier shift (all-pass, so white noise keeps its variance), re-checks the residual against max_misalign_px and marks the wrapped border invalid. A stack without structure (alignment["observable"] False) is neither refused nor shifted; its band is then only an intensity threshold on the overall variation. Stochastic textures, whose every sample shows a different pattern, are therefore not a variation-model problem (on DAGM 2007 Class1 it scores at chance — see the PoC).

spread_floor (>= 0, image units) lower-bounds the spread (8-bit data has pixels whose good samples are all equal); any remaining zero spread is refused. mask (H, W) bool limits the inspected area. Returns center, spread, k, far, n, df, spread_kind, lower / upper (the band), valid (bool), n_floored, d0 / s0 (the prior's degrees of freedom and scale: 0 for std / mad; for pooled and a fully pooled moderated prior d0 = valid pixels x (n - 1)), k_source, mc_far_rel_se and alignment (the offset report, after registration if any).

Raises ValueError on an empty / malformed / non-finite stack, too few samples, an unknown spread / align, far outside its range, a misaligned stack, a mask of the wrong shape, or zero spread left after the floor.
